question: Re-run L4004 on 2.1.1.0: did the bullet damage curves (health and armor) change in the own files or the registry defaults, and does the site's dmg list still equal the own health curve?

control.description: Control (note, Method step 2): restricted to the 63 site weapons' _WB and GS_ files and the site's bullet files, the registry-against-own pairing gives 2,771 / 11,500 / 567 values over 60 / 206 / 13 row names, exactly the 10 October counts (L4000), and the same paths.

sourceFacts.method: Step 4 of the note: curves.py then curve-compare.py read the own and registry-default damage curves of all 94 bullet files (88 on 1.4.3.5, curves-all.json of the 10 October run) and compare the site's dmg lists with the 2.1.1.0 own health curve.
sourceFacts.healthCurves: No change on the 69 bullet files that have both an own and a registry curve; registry equals own on all of them (3 files have an own curve and no registry curve, as before).
sourceFacts.siteDmgLists: Site dmg lists against the own health curve: on the 63 existing weapons 59 equal, 3 equal with an added 0 m point (M250, M277, Mini Scout) and 1 differing (M45A1, the reviewed 54 to 75 m step), the same split as on 10 October with no own curve moved; the four new weapons' lists equal their curves. The site holds no armor curve (its dmg lists are the health curves).

The two points pair the 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0 own armor curve of PD_762x51mmNATO_Semi (curve object at 216, values from offset 1492, 4 bytes each; the 1.4.3.5 offsets are the run of 10 October's curves-all.json firstOffset, and the reads here return the stated values).

inference: Health curves did not move; the armor curves of 13 bullet files changed and the registry default changed identically in each, so the own-versus-registry equality holds on both builds. The site's health-curve lists are unaffected.
unresolved: The armor curve changes are listed, not analysed (open item 5 of the note, L4055; checklist U23 reads 'probably REDSEC armour plates'): what they mean in game is not established, and the site holds no armor curve.
3 bullet files have an own curve and no registry curve; BROD 3 firing data, PD_545x39mm_MG, PD_9x39mm_Match and PD_9x39mm_Semi still have no registry rows to pair with.
siteImpact: None applied or proposed: the site's dmg lists are health curves and are unchanged (59 of 63 equal, 3 equal with an added 0 m point, M45A1 keeps its reviewed step).
